content.content: This layer reads the jj op log: the head before a run and again after it, and the entries the window between them carries, each with the workspace it is attributed to; the markers' read-run-read bracketing is fed from that read.
content.rationale: The markers' bracketing presupposes reading the op head before and after the operation; fixing the read here keeps marker capture fed while leaving the reversion — the write half — to its own leaf.
